3022	  const errors: PluginError[] = []
3023	  const managed = sources.managedNames
3024	
3025	  // Managed settings win over --plugin-dir. Drop session plugins whose
3026	  // name appears in policySettings.enabledPlugins (whether force-enabled
3027	  // OR force-disabled — both are admin intent that --plugin-dir must not
3028	  // bypass). Surface an error so the user knows why their dev copy was
3029	  // ignored.
3030	  //
3031	  // NOTE: managedNames contains the pluginId prefix (entry.name), which is
3032	  // expected to equal manifest.name by convention (schema description at
3033	  // schemas.ts PluginMarketplaceEntry.name). If a marketplace publishes a
3034	  // plugin where entry.name ≠ manifest.name, this guard will silently miss —
3035	  // but that's a marketplace misconfiguration that breaks other things too
3036	  // (e.g., ManagePlugins constructs pluginIds from manifest.name).
3037	  const sessionPlugins = sources.session.filter(p => {
3038	    if (managed?.has(p.name)) {
3039	      logForDebugging(
3040	        `Plugin "${p.name}" from --plugin-dir is blocked by managed settings`,
3041	        { level: 'warn' },
3042	      )
3043	      errors.push({
3044	        type: 'generic-error',
3045	        source: p.source,
3046	        plugin: p.name,
3047	        error: `--plugin-dir copy of "${p.name}" ignored: plugin is locked by managed settings`,
3048	      })
3049	      return false
3050	    }
3051	    return true
3052	  })
3053	
3054	  const sessionNames = new Set(sessionPlugins.map(p => p.name))
3055	  const marketplacePlugins = sources.marketplace.filter(p => {
3056	    if (sessionNames.has(p.name)) {
3057	      logForDebugging(
3058	        `Plugin "${p.name}" from --plugin-dir overrides installed version`,
3059	      )
3060	      return false
3061	    }
3062	    return true
3063	  })
3064	  // Session first, then non-overridden marketplace, then builtin.
3065	  // Downstream first-match consumers see session plugins before
3066	  // installed ones for any that slipped past the name filter.
3067	  return {
3068	    plugins: [...sessionPlugins, ...marketplacePlugins, ...sources.builtin],
3069	    errors,
3070	  }
3071	}

123	/**
124	 * Obtiene todos los plugins built-in registrados como objetos
125	 * `LoadedPlugin`, repartidos en habilitados/deshabilitados según settings
126	 * de usuario (con `defaultEnabled` como fallback). Los plugins cuyo
127	 * `isAvailable()` devuelve `false` se omiten enteramente.
128	 */
129	export function getBuiltinPlugins(): {
130	  enabled: LoadedPlugin[]
131	  disabled: LoadedPlugin[]
132	} {
133	  const settings = requireSettingsSettings().getSettings()
134	  const enabled: LoadedPlugin[] = []
135	  const disabled: LoadedPlugin[] = []
136	
137	  for (const [name, definition] of BUILTIN_PLUGINS) {
138	    if (definition.isAvailable && !definition.isAvailable()) {
139	      continue
140	    }
141	
142	    const pluginId = `${name}@${BUILTIN_MARKETPLACE_NAME}`
143	    const userSetting = settings?.enabledPlugins?.[pluginId]
144	    // Estado habilitado: preferencia de usuario > default del plugin > true.
145	    const isEnabled =
146	      userSetting !== undefined
147	        ? userSetting === true
148	        : (definition.defaultEnabled ?? true)
149	
150	    const plugin: LoadedPlugin = {
151	      name,
152	      manifest: {
153	        name,
154	        description: definition.description,
155	        version: definition.version,
156	      },
157	      path: BUILTIN_MARKETPLACE_NAME, // centinela — sin ruta de filesystem
158	      source: pluginId,
159	      repository: pluginId,
160	      enabled: isEnabled,
161	      isBuiltin: true,
162	      hooksConfig: definition.hooks,
163	      mcpServers: definition.mcpServers,
164	    }
165	
166	    if (isEnabled) {
167	      enabled.push(plugin)
168	    } else {
169	      disabled.push(plugin)
170	    }
171	  }
172	
173	  return { enabled, disabled }
174	}

/**
 * Plugin Loader Module
 *
 * This module is responsible for discovering, loading, and validating Claude Code plugins
 * from various sources including marketplaces and git repositories.
 *
 * NPM packages are also supported but must be referenced through marketplaces - the marketplace
 * entry contains the NPM package information.
 *
 * Plugin Discovery Sources (in order of precedence):
 * 1. Marketplace-based plugins (plugin@marketplace format in settings)
 * 2. Session-only plugins (from --plugin-dir CLI flag or SDK plugins option)
 *
 * Plugin Directory Structure:
 * ```
 * my-plugin/
 * ├── plugin.json          # Optional manifest with metadata
 * ├── commands/            # Custom slash commands
 * │   ├── build.md
 * │   └── deploy.md
 * ├── agents/              # Custom AI agents
 * │   └── test-runner.md
 * └── hooks/               # Hook configurations
 *     └── hooks.json       # Hook definitions
 * ```
 *
 * The loader handles:
 * - Plugin manifest validation
 * - Hooks configuration loading and variable resolution
 * - Duplicate name detection
 * - Enable/disable state management
 * - Error collection and reporting
 */
